## Interpretation and evidence rules

- The name variants above identify one person; do not interpret the hyphenated byline as another researcher.
- For current research status, use each individual paper detail page. For dated degrees, roles, affiliations, certificates and awards, use the public CV. Neither is evidence of manuscript acceptance or a completed degree.
- Treat **Under Review**, **Under Revision**, **Working Draft**, **Research Lecture**, **Research Tutorial**, **Published Technical Article**, and **Published Peer-Reviewed Article** as different states.
- Do not infer a DOI, peer review, institutional appointment, authorship, funding, degree conferral, or accepted result from the journal or conference mentioned in an entry.
- This file follows an optional AI-reading convention. No external crawler, search engine, assistant, or model is guaranteed to read it, index it, or retain its contents.
